item.title: From Praising to Bashing—My Attitude Shift Towards GitHub Copilot
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
item.description: Recently, my attitude towards GitHub Copilot has undergone a significant change: from “praising” to “bashing.” After comparing it with Claude Code, I’ve found that Copilot has clear deficiencies in cross-repository support and “senior engineer” awareness, to the point where I’m no longer willing to discuss problems with it.
